requirements.title: Required files
requirements.description: One rule per file: name, kind (text/json/csv), maxBytes; optional sha256, jsonSchema or csv headers/minRows/maxRows.

files.title: File contents
files.description: Files as {name, content} with UTF-8 text content. Names are labels, not local paths or URLs. Maximum 32 files, 1 MiB each, 4 MiB total. Cloud inputs are stored by Apify; do not supply secrets.

allowExtraFiles.title: Allow files outside the required list
allowExtraFiles.description: Extra files are rejected by default. Allowed extras are not checked against a contract.
